decisions.reason: The switched 5V rail rating and loads do not change the independently defined standalone USB 3.3V supply; its separate same-message details are already represented.
The MT3608 5V load allocation does not alter the AXP2101 battery, USB, VMID/VSYS, or DCDC1 power-path requirements.
The source assigns SPS30 and ZE08-CH2O to the 5V rail but does not establish their sensor-board interfaces; the separate I2C sensor details are already represented.
The switched-rail load and current details do not change the existing interboard connector types, pinouts, or matching-order rule.
The source describes system power rails and loads, not the battery connector series, pinout, mounting type, or unresolved labeling issue.
Specifying the MT3608 rail rating and powered loads does not change the component sourceability or cost policy.
The electrical power-allocation decision does not alter battery connector placement, orientation, spacing, or mounting-hole clearance.
The 5V rail load assignment does not change I2C speed, pull-ups, cable length, or series-resistor configuration.
The switched 5V rail specification does not change any power-board dimensions, layer count, connector form, mounting, or enclosure-fit constraint.
The source identifies the project's addressable LEDs as SK6812 devices and conditionally assigns them to the GPIO3-controlled MT3608 5V rail when the selected version is wired for 5V.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
3.3V rail (AXP2101 DCDC1, 2A) — primary power source when power board is connected:
\- ESP32-S3 module
\- INA219
\- All I2C sensors (SCD41, BME280, ENS160) via sensor board
\- I2C display
\- TTP223, AM312 PIR

5V rail (MT3608 boost, 500mA) — controlled by ESP32 GPIO3:
\- SPS30 particulate sensor
\- ZE08-CH2O formaldehyde sensor
\- SK6812 LEDs (if wired to 5V — depends on version)

3.3V rail (ME6211A LDO, 1A) — only active when USB-C on main board connected WITHOUT power board:
\- Same 3.3V rail as above — Schottky diode OR-ing means whichever source is present wins. Used for standalone programming.

Battery (3.7–4.2V) — feeds AXP2101 which then feeds everything above.

Simple rule: in normal operation AXP2101 powers everything. The LDO only kicks in when programming without the power board connected.

value_updates.power_supply_rule: Use the GPIO3-controlled MT3608 5V rail when the selected SK6812 version is wired for 5V
